subject: Azure Marketplace: Metering, DPA & Seller Authorization — redlines
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@luminahealth.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@luminahealth.com>; procurement@luminahealth.com
Date: 2026-07-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Questions on metering & DPA for Private Plan

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency/cost profile. Procurement has a couple of items they need clarified before we can move the Private Plan into our Azure Marketplace onboarding checklist:

1) Metering model: we bill our customers monthly based on consumed inference minutes. We need to confirm how metering records are exported from Redwood for Azure billing reconciliation (format, frequency, and signature).
2) DPA & data flows: we need a redlined DPA that explicitly lists telemetry and audit log retention policies for the private control plane. Our legal team also wants an audit clause for SOC2 evidence on request.
3) Seller authorization: Azure requires proof of seller authorization and SKU mapping for co-sell commitments — can you confirm the steps your side will take?

Can you share a proposed DPA redline and a sample export of the metering report? Ideally we can get this resolved this week so our procurement partner can issue the PO.

Best,
Alice Chen
Procurement Manager
Lumina Health

---

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@luminahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-22T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on metering & DPA for Private Plan

Hi Alice — thanks, glad the demo landed well. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

Metering exports: We provide daily metering CSV + weekly signed summary (SHA256) suitable for reconciliation. Columns: timestamp, sku_id, instance_type, tokens_in, tokens_out, inference_ms, user_org_id, request_id. We can add an optional customer-facing ID column if you need it.

DPA: Attached is our standard DPA with a procurement-friendly redline ("RI_Azure_DPA_redline_20260725.docx"). The redline adds explicit telemetry categories and sets audit evidence availability within 30 days for SOC2-related requests.

Seller auth & SKU mapping: Our marketplace ops team will generate a SKU mapping spreadsheet and a seller authorization packet — draft attached ("SKU_Mapping_Proposal.xlsx"). To complete Azure co-sell entitlements, we will: 1) confirm Seller ID in the Azure portal; 2) upload SKU mapping; 3) execute DocuSign for seller authorization. I can loop in Ben for the DocuSign step.

Next steps: Marissa will send our legal redline and proposed compromises. Ben will own seller auth & DocuSign flow. If procurement can confirm the PO timing and any required contract language, we can aim to finalize by Friday.

Thanks,
Sofia
Business GTM Lead, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RI_Azure_DPA_redline_20260725.docx, SKU_Mapping_Proposal.xlsx

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@luminahealth.com>, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-23T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Azure Marketplace: Metering, DPA & Seller Authorization — redlines

Hi Alice / Sofia — looping in legal comments. Summary of our position and proposed compromise items: 

1) Metering export cadence: we agree to provide daily machine-readable exports and a weekly signed CSV. We cannot change underlying telemetry retention for operational logs (default 90 days) but will commit to providing archived audit logs on request for up to 12 months in response to legal/audit queries subject to a standard NDA and documented request process.

2) DPA redlines: we accepted Lumina's request to enumerate telemetry categories. We declined language that would force on-site data dumping or unrestricted audit inspections; instead we propose a mutual audit clause with 30-day notice and scoping limits. Changes are tracked in the attached docx.

3) Seller Authorization: we can complete Azure seller authorization via DocuSign. However, SKU entitlements tied to co-sell incentives require confirmed purchase order numbers or a signed commitment. Without a PO we can still publish a private offer but co-sell revenue attribution may be delayed.

I've attached the redline and also a clean DPA for signature if Lumina prefers that route.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RI_Azure_DPA_redline_20260725.docx

From: Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@luminahealth.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-24T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: Metering, DPA & Seller Authorization — redlines

Marissa, Sofia — thanks for the rapid responses and the redline. A few clarifying points from our side after an internal legal check:

- The 90-day operational log retention is fine as long as you can produce archived logs for 12 months on request. Please confirm the exact export format for archived logs (JSON, CSV) and whether timestamps are in UTC.
- For the mutual audit clause: Lumina's team wants a maximum two audits per 12-month period for critical vendors. Is that acceptable? If not, propose a limit.
- On the PO: procurement can issue an initial commitment (stub PO) that allows seller auth to proceed. Final PO/amount will follow once we reconcile the first month's metering report. Can you confirm Redwood can proceed with seller auth with a stub PO?

We want to keep momentum — can we get a one-line yes/no on these three points and the DocuSign link for seller auth?

Regards,
Tom
Director, Vendor Procurement
Lumina Health

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@luminahealth.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@luminahealth.com>
Cc: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-27T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: Metering, DPA & Seller Authorization — redlines

Hi Tom / Alice — Ben here, ops lead for marketplace onboarding. Quick answers: 

1) Archived logs: we can provide archived exports as compressed JSONL or CSV (UTC timestamps). We will include the schema and a small sample when we send the export.

2) Vendor audits: Redwood accepts up to two vendor audits per 12 months, with each audit scoped to specific services and with 30-day advance notice. We'll add the scope definition to the DPA redline.

3) Stub PO: Yes — we can begin Seller Authorization with a stub PO that confirms intent and includes an internal reference number. We will not enable co-sell revenue attribution until final PO reconciliation, but the private offer can be published and your Azure seller ID can be linked.

DocuSign seller auth link: https://www.docusign.com/Signing/?s=abc123 (also attached as DocuSign_SellerAuth_Link.txt)

Next steps: I will upload the SKU mapping in the portal once we have the stub PO number (please send one-line confirmation). After DocuSign completes we have a short 48-72 hour ops window to finish portal configuration.

Best,
Ben Carter
Marketplace Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: DocuSign_SellerAuth_Link.txt, SKU_Mapping_Proposal.xlsx

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@luminahealth.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-29T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: Metering, DPA & Seller Authorization — redlines

Thanks team — confirmed on our side. Procurement will send a stub PO today: PO-STUB-8891. We reviewed the redline and Lumina legal accepts the two-audit cap with the proposed scoping language. Please proceed with DocuSign and seller auth.

Action items agreed:
- Lumina: send stub PO (PO-STUB-8891) — DONE by procurement (email sent).
- Redwood: start DocuSign for seller authorization and upload SKU mapping to the Azure portal within 48 hours of DocuSign completion.
- Redwood Legal: finalize DPA with the audit scoping language and provide final signable copy.

If we hit any snags on the portal mapping, Alice/Tom will loop their Azure marketplace admin. Otherwise we should be able to close the private offer publishing this week.

Best regards,
Alice Chen
Procurement Manager
Lumina Health
